page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-180-lssd is a high-capacity general-purpose server powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 180 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 90 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 720 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled directly with the instance, consisting of 16 local NVMe SSDs that deliver a combined capacity of 6432 GB of high-speed local storage.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier for multi-core processing and memory performance. The AMD EPYC processor achieves top-10% scores in multi-core stress-ng tests, PassMark CPU evaluations, and Geekbench multi-core runs. Its memory subsystem demonstrates exceptional throughput, with small-block cached read bandwidth reaching 13529.71 GB/sec and large-block uncached read speeds of 345.79 GB/sec. The CPU architecture includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16) and cryptography acceleration (AES and SHA_NI), which drive top-tier performance in encryption, physics simulations, and software compilation.

Given its massive compute density and high-speed local NVMe storage, the c3d-standard-180-lssd is highly cost-efficient for resource-intensive enterprise workloads that require high local I/O performance without the overhead of network-attached storage. It is exceptionally well-suited for high-throughput Redis caching layers, serving up to 211.54 million operations per second, and large-scale database operations. Additionally, the instance excels at CPU-based LLM inference, static web serving, and parallelized software compilation tasks.
